behavioral_observations.procedure: Execute installContractDefaults against an empty target-scoped database fixture and the real database integration fixture with DEFAULT_CONTRACT_ID pointing to a missing source.
behavioral_observations.expected: All product defaults are installed using only the authenticated target contract.
behavioral_observations.observed: Exact-head unit and database integration tests are declared in the executed monorepo test suite; the workflow enables RUN_DATABASE_INTEGRATION_TESTS=true and the Test gate passed.

behavioral_observations.procedure: POST /contracts/install-defaults with attacker contractId and targetContractId values while the authenticated session is session-contract.
behavioral_observations.expected: The body cannot override the target; installation receives session-contract only.
behavioral_observations.observed: Exact-head route test asserts installContractDefaults(session-contract), rejects attacker-contract as target, and the Test gate passed.

behavioral_observations.procedure: Run installation with DEFAULT_CONTRACT_ID absent, empty, invalid, and pointing to a foreign tenant.
behavioral_observations.expected: Installation succeeds identically without using DEFAULT_CONTRACT_ID.
behavioral_observations.observed: Exact-head parameterized service test covers all four values and the Test gate passed.

behavioral_observations.procedure: Seed foreign-only parameter, assessment and exercise sentinels under foreign-contract, then install defaults into target-contract.
behavioral_observations.expected: No foreign sentinel appears in the target and every read remains scoped to target-contract.
behavioral_observations.observed: Exact-head service test asserts all three sentinels remain absent from target and target-only reads; the Test gate passed.

behavioral_observations.procedure: Preload one canonical item plus customized target records and install defaults.
behavioral_observations.expected: Only missing canonical items are created and customized target values remain unchanged.
behavioral_observations.observed: Exact-head service test verifies missing-count deltas and preservation of custom parameter description, assessment, and exercise; the Test gate passed.

behavioral_observations.procedure: Exercise assessment initial states: custom-only, intermediate-only, complete-only, and both canonical types.
behavioral_observations.expected: Only missing canonical codes are created; custom assessment exists only in the custom-only case and retains intervalMonths=7.
behavioral_observations.observed: The current material commit corrected this exact parameterized assertion; CI on the corrected SHA passed the Test gate.

behavioral_observations.procedure: Run the installation twice on the same target fixture.
behavioral_observations.expected: Second execution installs zero items and reports all canonical items as skipped.
behavioral_observations.observed: Exact-head service test asserts installed=0 for all categories and skipped equals each canonical catalog length; the Test gate passed.

behavioral_observations.procedure: Compare runtime exercise loader with exercises-data.json and inspect seed/runtime/assessment imports of shared product constants.
behavioral_observations.expected: Exercises derive from the canonical JSON; parameter and assessment maintenance/runtime paths consume the same shared definitions.
behavioral_observations.observed: Exact-head source-contract test asserts JSON name parity, shared PRODUCT_TRAINING_PARAMETERS and PRODUCT_ASSESSMENT_TYPES imports, 26 training parameters, and assessment codes intermediate/complete; the Test gate passed.

behavioral_observations.procedure: Exercise /contracts/clone-data without sourceContractId and with explicit sourceContractId.
behavioral_observations.expected: No-source installs product defaults with legacy counters; explicit source invokes manual copy with session target.
behavioral_observations.observed: Exact-head route tests assert both branches and legacy counters; the Test gate passed.

behavioral_observations.procedure: Click Instalar padrões do sistema, then exercise success, pending duplicate click, API error, and malformed-success response.
behavioral_observations.expected: One install request is sent, pending double-submit is blocked, and success/error feedback remains in the action card.
behavioral_observations.observed: Exact-head web tests assert endpoint, counters, disabled pending button, and in-card error states; the monorepo Test gate passed.

behavioral_observations.procedure: Compare runtime contract with docs/architecture/contract-defaults.md and execute repository documentation gate.
behavioral_observations.expected: Documentation states repository-owned defaults, authenticated target, explicit cross-contract copy, and no DEFAULT_CONTRACT_ID dependency.
behavioral_observations.observed: Exact-head architecture document contains those claims and Documentation checks passed.

behavioral_observations.procedure: Compare the stale certificate material SHA with current PR head and current head parent/path, then classify recovery using classify_handoff_recovery.py with the auditor floor post-write-refreeze.
behavioral_observations.expected: A material write after freeze invalidates the old handoff and forces post-write refreeze before a new result-only child.
behavioral_observations.observed: Recovery classifier returned post-write-refreeze for stale material 19de4d... versus current material head 5f8face... whose material test path changed.
